reviews.text:
We left our dog Roma with Kike and his family for a day, and it was fantastic. It was the first time we'd been separated from her, and we felt completely at ease. We met the whole family, including their dog Luna, the day before, and they immediately made us feel calm and confident. We knew we were leaving Roma in good hands. Roma is very affectionate, and we were sure they would give her all the love she needed. They were very attentive and sent us photos throughout the entire time. Roma had a wonderful time, and we were thrilled. Thank you so much, Kike and family!

😘😘😘😘
Very pleasant service and easy to communicate with Kike!

It was such a stroke of luck to find Minidog to look after our Bichon Frise this summer. They were incredibly attentive, loving, and careful at all times, and kept us updated every day with photos, videos, and comments about how his day had gone, what he'd been doing, and how he was doing.

It was clear that our pet was happy and very well cared for. In fact, when we went to pick him up, he didn't want to leave their side! 🥹 That speaks volumes about the love and attention he received.

A fantastic find. We will definitely trust them again. Thank you so much for taking such good care of Desco! ❤️
Thanks Miguel! 🐶🐶🐶👏👏🫶 I hope to see you soon, you know where I am 👌🐶 …

What a joy to have discovered Minidog! A wonderful family who showered our furry friend Melchor with love and care. Thank you so much for all the support and all the videos and photos you shared with us every day, showing Melchor so happy! 1000% recommended!

We left Rita with Sara and Kike for a week and we couldn't be happier. They took such good care of her, and we were completely at ease throughout the trip knowing she was in the best hands. ❤️ Plus, the biggest bonus was Luna 🐶, their dog, who was a wonderful companion and support for Rita.

Thank you so much for taking such good care of her. We'll definitely be back! 🐾💕
Charming and affectionate. We are delighted with MiniDog.

We are so grateful for your attention during a difficult time when we urgently needed the care of an excellent caregiver, and you cared for our precious child with so much love. Thank you for being there.

Our dog had a fantastic time, and we were so happy to enjoy an outing knowing he was in Kike's care. He was incredibly attentive, affectionate, doting, and careful. He kept us updated on how our dog was doing and gave us great peace of mind knowing he was in excellent hands. I recommend him 100%. I don't think he even missed us, he was having such a great time with Lunita and Bob. We now have our official dog sitter!

We were worried about leaving our dog Pegui alone while we were away for work. But I was so pleased with the care and affection Pegui received from them. They were very attentive, kind, and understanding with Pegui, as she's a bit of a difficult dog to handle. It puts my mind at ease knowing she's in good hands while I'm at work.
They took great care of my puppy. I'll definitely be back.

Our pet's experience with Sara and Kike has been fantastic. They kept us updated every day, even sending photos.
It's clear they love animals. Highly recommended. We will definitely be back.
100% Recommended

Kike, his wife, and Lunita welcomed Lala into their home with so much love and affection, as if it were their own. I was delighted with their service. I recommend them 100%. When you need to travel and have your dog cared for as if she were at home, they are the perfect choice.

Kike and his family provided a safe and loving environment for our dog. They welcomed her into their routine as a full-fledged member of the family and were always attentive to her well-being. During her stay, they sent us daily updates and beautiful photos. We highly recommend them.
My dog ​​Coffee stayed there for 5 days and everything was perfect. A friendly and caring environment.
I left my dog ​​with them this week, and I highly recommend them. They kept me updated on her and sent photos at all times. Thank you!

We left our Bichon Luca at MiniDog and it was the best decision we could have made. The treatment, care, and affection are the same as we would have given him at home. They see him as one of their own family and they show it. Thank you so much, guys!
The family treated the dog like he was one of their own, I'll definitely be back 👏🏻 …
Highly recommended, we'll be back!
My dog ​​was very well cared for and received personalized attention, as I wanted him to be calm and well cared for in an apartment.
Kike's dedication is wonderful. His enthusiasm is evident and reflected in his work and the care he shows to the pets.
Excellent, very professional service
Excellent service, great care for our pets. Highly recommended.
Highly recommended.
He's a great caregiver; my dog ​​is always very happy.
No one has ever given me so much confidence. It's so nice to leave our dog with them and know he'll be fine every time! We'll definitely be back!
He's amazing. Super careful and super loving with them. Highly recommended.

A very good experience. My dog ​​was very well cared for the weekend I had to be away for a short vacation that prevented me from traveling with him. A friendly, family atmosphere and an adorable little dog to keep us company while we were gone. We will definitely be back, thank you!
